Details.title: Details
Details.description:
The full quote-builder payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this:

{"title":"Quote","cartId":"QT-00042","statusLabel":"Draft quote","shipTo":"Rivera Robotics · Plant 2","shipToId":"#PL-2-0192","billTo":"Rivera Manufacturing, Inc.","currency":"USD","lineItems":[{"id":"frame","itemNumber":"TB-9000-FRM","description":"Assembly cell frame, powder-coated steel","uom":"EA","unitPrice":4800,"quantity":2},{"id":"plc","itemNumber":"PLC-ADV-24","description":"Advanced PLC + HMI control package","uom":"EA","unitPrice":5400,"quantity":1},{"id":"conv","itemNumber":"CONV-3M","description":"Conveyor belt module, 3 m span","uom":"EA","unitPrice":1260,"quantity":3},{"id":"safety","itemNumber":"SAF-LC-KIT","description":"Light-curtain safety kit","uom":"KIT","unitPrice":980,"quantity":1}],"poLabel":"Purchase Order #","poPlaceholder":"Enter PO number...","acknowledgeText":"I acknowledge that pricing is an estimate pending a formal quote and confirm the configuration is correct.","secondaryText":"Save & close","submitText":"Request quote","submitValue":"Request a formal quote for this configured order"}

This card is a cart / quote review: a header (cart id + status + ship-to / bill-to), a line-items table with per-line quantity steppers, and an order-details block (PO number, subtotal, a shipping estimate, an estimated total, and an acknowledgement checkbox that gates submit).

Rules:
- 'title' (string, optional): quote heading. Defaults to 'Quote'. Used as the card heading only when 'cartId' is absent.
- 'cartId' (string, optional): quote / cart number shown as the card heading (e.g. 'QT-00042'). Takes visual precedence over 'title'.
- 'statusLabel' (string, optional): short status pill (e.g. 'Draft quote', 'Pending approval').
- 'shipTo' (string, optional): ship-to account or site name.
- 'shipToId' (string, optional): short ship-to reference (e.g. '#PL-2-0192').
- 'billTo' (string, optional): bill-to legal entity.
- 'currency' (string, optional): ISO code (default USD). Prices show up to 2 decimals.
- 'lineItems' (array, REQUIRED, 1 to 8 objects): each line MUST have 'description' (string). Optional per line: 'id' (string, unique — defaults to a positional id), 'itemNumber' (string, catalog / part number; shown as '—' when omitted), 'uom' (string, unit of measure e.g. 'EA','KIT'), 'unitPrice' (number, price per unit; 0 or omitted hides that line's unit price and line total), 'quantity' (number, min 1, default 1 — the customer adjusts it with the per-line stepper; decrementing below 1 removes the line).
- 'poLabel' (string, optional): label for the PO field. Defaults to 'Purchase Order #'.
- 'poPlaceholder' (string, optional): placeholder for the PO input. Defaults to 'Enter PO number...'.
- 'shippingText' (string, optional): what to show for shipping before fees are calculated. Defaults to '—'. The card computes the actual fee on 'Calculate fees' as max(150, 3.5% of subtotal) — do NOT send a shipping amount.
- 'acknowledgeText' (string, optional): a terms line rendered with a checkbox that MUST be ticked before the primary action is enabled. Defaults to a standard estimate acknowledgement; pass an empty string ("") to remove the checkbox entirely.
- 'secondaryText' (string, optional): secondary button label (e.g. 'Save & close'). Omit to hide it.
- 'submitText' (string, optional): primary action-button label; defaults to 'Request quote'.
- 'submitValue' (string, optional): a base message; the card appends the line items, PO number, and estimated total when sending back.

The card computes the subtotal (sum of unitPrice × quantity), the shipping estimate, and the estimated total itself — never send precomputed totals. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
